name: InvenTree BoM Checker
description: Check PCB component availability and approved substitutes in InvenTree, directly inside KiCad.
description_full: A native PCB Editor Action Plugin for KiCad 9 and 10. Read the open PCB or import CSV, iBOM HTML and KiCad XML. View stock results, search inventory, associate parts and export reports. Uses read-only InvenTree requests. Optional persistent tokens use Windows account encryption. KiCad 11 is not supported by this SWIG package.
